rules.rule_name: Route ENTER Key to Selection and Search Processing
rules.rule_description: When the user presses the ENTER key on the Transaction List screen, the system routes processing to handle any transaction row selections and/or transaction ID search criteria entered by the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Process User Selections and Search Criteria ENTER Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and has optionally entered a selection indicator next to a transaction row and/or a Transaction ID in the search field
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the ENTER key to submit their input
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system routes control to the selection and search processing logic, which evaluates any row selections (S/s) and the Transaction ID search field to determine the appropriate next action

rules.rule_name: Route PF3 Key to Return to Main Menu
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 on the Transaction List screen, the system navigates the user back to the Main Menu screen, exiting the transaction list.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Return to Main Menu PF3 Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the Main Menu (COMEN01C) and transfers control to that screen, exiting the Transaction List

rules.rule_name: Route PF7 Key to Previous Page Navigation
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF7 on the Transaction List screen, the system routes processing to the backward page navigation logic to display the previous page of transactions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Navigate to Previous Page PF7 Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen viewing a page of transactions
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF7 key to scroll to the previous page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system routes control to the backward page navigation processing logic to retrieve and display the previous set of up to 10 transactions

rules.rule_name: Route PF8 Key to Next Page Navigation
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8 on the Transaction List screen, the system routes processing to the forward page navigation logic to display the next page of transactions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Navigate to Next Page PF8 Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen viewing a page of transactions
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF8 key to scroll to the next page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system routes control to the forward page navigation processing logic to retrieve and display the next set of up to 10 transactions

rules.rule_name: Reject and Report Invalid Function Key Press
rules.rule_description: When the user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF7, or PF8 on the Transaction List screen, the system treats it as an invalid action, sets an error condition, and redisplays the current Transaction List screen with an invalid key error message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Invalid Key Error Message Any Other Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF7, or PF8 (e.g., PF1, PF2, PF4, PF5, PF6, PF9, PA keys, etc.)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', positions the cursor on the Transaction ID input field, displays the standard invalid key error message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) at the bottom of the screen, and redisplays the Transaction List screen without changing any displayed transaction data

rules.rule_name: Detect and Capture Row 1 Transaction Selection
rules.rule_description: When the user enters a selection value in the first row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 1 for further processing. Row 1 is evaluated first and takes priority over all other rows.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Row 1 Selected?
SEL0001I not blank?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, and the user has interacted with the screen by pressing ENTER
acceptance_criteria.When: The selection field for Row 1 (SEL0001I) contains a value that is neither blank nor empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures the selection indicator entered by the user from Row 1 into the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG), and captures the Transaction ID displayed in Row 1 (TRNID01I) into the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED), and no further rows are evaluated

rules.rule_name: Detect and Capture Row 2 Transaction Selection
rules.rule_description: When Row 1 has no selection and the user enters a selection value in the second row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 2.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Row 2 Selected?
SEL0002I not blank?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, the user has pressed ENTER, and the selection field for Row 1 (SEL0001I) is blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.When: The selection field for Row 2 (SEL0002I) contains a value that is neither blank nor empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures the selection indicator entered by the user from Row 2 into the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG), and captures the Transaction ID displayed in Row 2 (TRNID02I) into the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED), and no further rows are evaluated

rules.rule_name: Detect and Capture Row 3 Transaction Selection
rules.rule_description: When Rows 1 and 2 have no selection and the user enters a selection value in the third row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 3.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Row 3 Selected?
SEL0003I not blank?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, the user has pressed ENTER, and the selection fields for Rows 1 (SEL0001I) and 2 (SEL0002I) are both blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.When: The selection field for Row 3 (SEL0003I) contains a value that is neither blank nor empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures the selection indicator entered by the user from Row 3 into the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG), and captures the Transaction ID displayed in Row 3 (TRNID03I) into the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED), and no further rows are evaluated

rules.rule_name: Detect and Capture Row 4 Transaction Selection
rules.rule_description: When Rows 1 through 3 have no selection and the user enters a selection value in the fourth row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 4.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Row 4 Selected?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a non-blank value in one of the 10 transaction row selection fields on the Transaction List screen, and the system has captured that selection value and the corresponding Transaction ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the captured selection flag value
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the selection value is 'S' or 's', the system proceeds to navigate to the Transaction Detail screen; if the selection value is anything other than 'S' or 's', the system sets the error message to 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' and re-displays the Transaction List screen with the error message

rules.rule_name: Navigate to Transaction Detail Screen on Valid Selection
rules.rule_description: When a user selects a transaction using the valid selection value 'S' or 's', the system transfers control to the Transaction Detail screen, passing the selected Transaction ID and current session context so the user can view the full details of the chosen transaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Navigate to Transaction Detail Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered 'S' or 's' in a selection field next to a transaction row, and the system has validated the selection value and confirmed the selected Transaction ID is non-blank
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the valid selection
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to 'COTRN01C' (Transaction Detail screen), records the current transaction name and program name as the originating context, resets the program context to 0, and transfers control to the Transaction Detail screen passing the full session communication area including the selected Transaction ID

rules.rule_name: Display Error Message for Invalid Selection Value
rules.rule_description: When a user enters a selection value other than 'S' or 's' in any transaction row selection field, the system must inform the user of the valid selection option by displaying a specific error message on the Transaction List screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Message: 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a value in a transaction row selection field that is not 'S' and not 's' (e.g., 'X', 'D', '1', or any other character)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the selection value and determines it is not a valid selection indicator
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error message to 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' and positions the cursor on the Transaction ID input field, then re-displays the Transaction List screen showing the error message to the user

rules.rule_name: Re-display Transaction List Screen After Invalid Selection
rules.rule_description: After detecting an invalid selection value, the system re-displays the Transaction List screen with the error message visible, allowing the user to correct their selection. The screen is sent without erasing the existing content so the current transaction list remains visible.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Re-display Transaction List Screen with Error Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has set the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' due to an invalid selection entry, and the cursor has been positioned on the Transaction ID input field
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Transaction List screen back to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction List screen is re-displayed with the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' shown in the message area, the existing transaction list data remains on screen, and processing continues to the Transaction ID search validation step without navigating away from the screen

rules.rule_name: Continue to Transaction ID Search After Selection Processing
rules.rule_description: Regardless of whether a selection was made (valid, invalid, or absent), the system always continues to process the Transaction ID search field after completing selection validation. This ensures the transaction list is refreshed or filtered based on any Transaction ID the user may have entered.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Continue Processing Transaction ID Search

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed evaluation of all selection fields — either no selection was made, a valid selection navigated to detail screen, or an invalid selection displayed an error message
acceptance_criteria.When: Selection processing is complete (for the invalid or no-selection paths)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system proceeds to evaluate the Transaction ID search input field: if blank, the list starts from the beginning of the transaction file; if numeric, the list starts from that Transaction ID; if non-numeric, an error message 'Tran ID must be Numeric...' is displayed and the screen is re-shown

key_functionalities.title: Transaction ID Search Input Validation
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Transaction ID Search Validation])
    B{Is Transaction ID\nSearch Field Blank?}
    C[Set Search Key to Beginning\nof Transaction File]
    D{Is Entered Transaction ID\nNumeric?}
    E[Accept Transaction ID\nas Valid Search Key]
    F[Set Error Flag ON]
    G[Set Error Message:\n'Tran ID must be Numeric...']
    H[Position Cursor on\nTransaction ID Field]
    I[Re-display Transaction\nList Screen with Error]
    J([Continue to\nLoad Transactions])
    K([End: Await\nUser Correction])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - Field is Blank| C
    C --> J
    B -->|No - Value Entered| D
    D -->|Yes - Numeric| E
    E --> J
    D -->|No - Non-Numeric| F
    F --> G
    G --> H
    H --> I
    I --> K

rules.rule_name: Blank Transaction ID Search Field Defaults to Beginning of Transaction List
rules.rule_description: When the user leaves the Transaction ID search field empty on the Transaction List screen and presses ENTER, the system treats the search as starting from the very beginning of the transaction file, effectively retrieving transactions from the first available record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Transaction ID Search Field Blank? → Set Search Key to Beginning of Transaction File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and the Transaction ID search input field contains only spaces or is empty (blank/null value)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses ENTER to initiate a transaction search
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the internal transaction search key to the lowest possible value (beginning of file), so that the transaction list is loaded starting from the very first available transaction record, and processing continues to load and display the transaction list

rules.rule_name: Numeric Transaction ID Search Value Accepted as Valid Search Key
rules.rule_description: When the user enters a value in the Transaction ID search field, the system validates that the entered value is numeric. If the value is numeric, it is accepted as a valid search key and used to position the transaction list starting from that Transaction ID.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Entered Transaction ID Numeric? → Accept Transaction ID as Valid Search Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and has entered a non-blank value in the Transaction ID search input field
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and the entered Transaction ID value contains only numeric digits
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system accepts the entered Transaction ID as a valid search key, stores it as the transaction file search position key, and continues to load and display the transaction list starting from that Transaction ID

rules.rule_name: Non-Numeric Transaction ID Search Value Rejected with Error Message
rules.rule_description: When the user enters a non-numeric value in the Transaction ID search field, the system rejects the input, sets an error condition, displays the error message 'Tran ID must be Numeric...', positions the cursor back on the Transaction ID field, and re-displays the Transaction List screen so the user can correct the entry. No transaction search is performed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Entered Transaction ID Numeric? → No - Non-Numeric → Set Error Flag ON → Set Error Message → Position Cursor on Transaction ID Field → Re-display Transaction List Screen with Error

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and has entered a non-blank value in the Transaction ID search input field
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and the entered Transaction ID value contains non-numeric characters (letters, special characters, or alphanumeric mix)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y' (ON), sets the error message to 'Tran ID must be Numeric...', positions the cursor on the Transaction ID input field, re-displays the Transaction List screen showing the error message, and halts further transaction search processing — awaiting user correction

key_functionalities.title: Transaction ID Search Initialization
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Process Transaction ID Search Field])
    B{Is Transaction ID\nSearch Field Blank?}
    C[Set Search Key to\nLowest Possible Value\nStart from Beginning of File]
    D[Use Entered Transaction ID\nas Search Starting Point]
    E([Proceed to Load\nTransaction Page Forward])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - Field is Blank| C
    B -->|No - Value Entered| D
    C --> E
    D --> E

rules.rule_name: Blank Transaction ID Defaults to Beginning of Transaction List
rules.rule_description: When the user leaves the Transaction ID search field empty, the system automatically sets the search starting point to the lowest possible value so that the transaction list is retrieved from the very beginning of the available records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Transaction ID Search Field Blank?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and has submitted the screen by pressing ENTER
acceptance_criteria.When: The Transaction ID search field is left blank (contains spaces or no value)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the internal search key to the lowest possible value, ensuring the transaction list browse starts from the very first available transaction record in the system

rules.rule_name: Valid Numeric Transaction ID Used as Search Starting Point
rules.rule_description: When the user enters a numeric Transaction ID in the search field, the system uses that value as the starting point for browsing the transaction list, displaying records from that transaction onwards.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use Entered Transaction ID as Search Starting Point

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and has submitted the screen by pressing ENTER
acceptance_criteria.When: The Transaction ID search field contains a non-blank, numeric value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system uses the entered Transaction ID as the search key to start browsing the transaction file, so the transaction list is displayed beginning from that specific Transaction ID

rules.rule_name: Non-Numeric Transaction ID Entry is Rejected
rules.rule_description: When the user enters a non-numeric value in the Transaction ID search field, the system rejects the input, displays a validation error message, and keeps the user on the Transaction List screen without performing any search.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Transaction ID Search Field Blank?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and has submitted the screen by pressing ENTER
acceptance_criteria.When: The Transaction ID search field contains a non-blank value that is not numeric
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Tran ID must be Numeric ...' on the Transaction List screen, positions the cursor on the Transaction ID field, and does not proceed to load any transaction records

rules.rule_name: Page Counter Reset Before Loading Transaction List
rules.rule_description: After the Transaction ID search key has been established (either from user input or defaulted to the beginning), the page counter is always reset to zero before the forward page load is initiated, ensuring the display starts at page 1.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Proceed to Load Transaction Page Forward

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction ID search field has been validated and the search key has been set (either to the entered Transaction ID or to the lowest possible value)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is about to retrieve and display the transaction list
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system resets the current page number to zero and then initiates the forward page loading process to populate and display the first page of the transaction list

key_functionalities.title: Forward Page Navigation (PF8)
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Presses PF8\nForward Page Navigation])
    B{Is Last Transaction ID\nof Current Page Available?}
    C[Set Starting Point to\nLast Transaction ID of Current Page]

    E{Is There a\nNext Page Available?}
    F[Display Message:\nAlready at Bottom of the Page]

    A --> B

    H --> I
    I --> J
    J --> K
    K --> L
    L -->|Record Read| M
    M --> N
    N -->|More Records and\nFewer than 10 Rows Filled| K
    N -->|10 Rows Filled or\nNo More Records| O
    O --> P
    P -->|Record Found| Q
    P -->|No Record Found| R
    Q --> S
    R --> S
    S --> T
    T --> U

rules.rule_name: Determine Starting Point When Last Transaction ID Is Available
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8 to navigate forward, the system determines the browse starting point based on whether the last transaction ID of the current page is recorded.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Last Transaction ID of Current Page Available?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing a page of transactions and presses PF8 to navigate to the next page
acceptance_criteria.When: The last transaction ID of the current page (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST) is available (not spaces and not low-values)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the transaction browse starting point (TRAN-ID) to the last transaction ID of the current page (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST)

rules.rule_name: Determine Starting Point When Last Transaction ID Is Not Available
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8 but no last transaction ID is recorded for the current page, the system defaults the browse starting point to the end of the transaction file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Starting Point to End of File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and presses PF8 to navigate forward
acceptance_criteria.When: The last transaction ID of the current page (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST) is blank or empty (spaces or low-values)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the transaction browse starting point (TRAN-ID) to HIGH-VALUES, representing the end of the transaction file

rules.rule_name: Block Forward Navigation When Already on Last Page
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to navigate forward but there are no more pages of transactions available, the system prevents navigation and informs the user they are already at the last page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Message: Already at Bottom of the Page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the last page of the transaction list
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF8 and the next-page indicator (NEXT-PAGE flag) is set to NO (NEXT-PAGE-YES is FALSE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' and re-displays the current transaction list screen without changing the page content

rules.rule_name: Open Transaction File Browse from Last Transaction ID
rules.rule_description: When forward navigation is permitted, the system initiates a sequential browse of the transaction file starting at the determined transaction ID position.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Open Transaction File Browse from Last Transaction ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The next-page indicator confirms more transactions are available and a starting transaction ID (TRAN-ID) has been set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins forward page processing (PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system opens a browse session on the transaction file (WS-TRANSACT-FILE) positioned at the specified TRAN-ID key

rules.rule_name: Skip Past the Last Transaction ID of the Current Page
rules.rule_description: After opening the browse at the last transaction ID of the current page, the system advances one record forward to skip past that already-displayed transaction before populating the new page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Skip Past the Last Transaction ID of Current Page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction file browse has been opened at the last transaction ID of the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The triggering action is PF8 (not ENTER, PF7, or PF3)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads the next transaction record (READNEXT) once to move the browse cursor past the current page's last transaction, so the new page starts with the record immediately following it

rules.rule_name: Clear All Transaction Display Rows Before Populating New Page
rules.rule_description: Before populating the screen with new transaction data, all 10 transaction display rows are cleared to ensure no stale data from the previous page remains visible.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear All 10 Transaction Display Rows on Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The browse cursor is positioned past the last transaction of the current page and the system is ready to populate the next page
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins loading new transaction records for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system clears all 10 transaction rows on the screen by setting Transaction ID, Transaction Date, Transaction Description, and Transaction Amount fields (rows 1 through 10: TRNID01I–TRNID10I, TDATE01I–TDATE10I, TDESC01I–TDESC10I, TAMT001I–TAMT010I) to spaces

rules.rule_name: Read and Populate Up to 10 Transaction Records for New Page
rules.rule_description: The system sequentially reads transaction records from the file and populates each of the 10 display rows with transaction details until either 10 rows are filled or no more records are available.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Next Transaction Record from File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction file browse is open and positioned past the last transaction of the previous page, and all 10 display rows have been cleared
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads transaction records sequentially (READNEXT) in a loop
acceptance_criteria.Then: For each successfully read record (up to a maximum of 10), the system populates the corresponding display row with: Transaction ID (TRAN-ID), Transaction Date formatted as MM/DD/YY (derived from TRAN-ORIG-TS), Transaction Description (TRAN-DESC), and Transaction Amount (TRAN-AMT); the loop continues until 10 rows are filled or end-of-file is reached

rules.rule_name: Record First Transaction ID of New Page
rules.rule_description: When populating the first row of the new page, the system records the transaction ID as the first transaction ID of the current page, enabling backward navigation (PF7) later.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Row with Transaction ID, Date, Description and Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is populating transaction rows for the new page
acceptance_criteria.When: The first transaction record (row index WS-IDX = 1) is being populated
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system stores the Transaction ID into both the first display row (TRNID01I) and the first-transaction-ID tracker (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST)

rules.rule_name: Record Last Transaction ID of New Page
rules.rule_description: When populating the tenth (last) row of the new page, the system records the transaction ID as the last transaction ID of the current page, enabling forward navigation (PF8) in subsequent interactions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Row with Transaction ID, Date, Description and Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is populating transaction rows for the new page
acceptance_criteria.When: The tenth transaction record (row index WS-IDX = 10) is being populated
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system stores the Transaction ID into both the last display row (TRNID10I) and the last-transaction-ID tracker (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST)

rules.rule_name: Check for Additional Records Beyond the New Page
rules.rule_description: After filling up to 10 transaction rows, the system attempts to read one additional record to determine whether a further next page exists, enabling or disabling the PF8 forward navigation for the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Attempt to Read One Additional Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has finished populating the new page with up to 10 transaction records
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to read one more transaction record beyond the 10 displayed
acceptance_criteria.Then: If an additional record is found, the system marks the next-page indicator as YES (NEXT-PAGE-YES = TRUE), indicating more pages are available; if no additional record is found (end-of-file), the system marks the next-page indicator as NO (NEXT-PAGE-NO = TRUE), indicating this is the last page

rules.rule_name: Increment Page Number After Successful Forward Navigation
rules.rule_description: After successfully loading a new forward page of transactions, the system increments the page counter by 1 to reflect the user's current position in the transaction list.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Increment Page Number by 1

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has successfully loaded transaction records for the next page (at least one record was read, WS-IDX > 1) or all 10 rows were filled
acceptance_criteria.When: The forward page population loop completes
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system increments the current page number (CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM) by 1 and displays the updated page number (PAGENUMI) on the transaction list screen

rules.rule_name: Close Transaction File Browse After Page Load
rules.rule_description: After all transaction records for the new page have been read and the next-page indicator has been set, the system closes the transaction file browse session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Close File Browse

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed reading transaction records for the new page and has determined whether a further next page exists
acceptance_criteria.When: All page population processing is complete
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system closes the browse session on the transaction file (WS-TRANSACT-FILE) using ENDBR

rules.rule_name: Display Updated Transaction List Screen with New Page Data
rules.rule_description: After successfully loading the next page of transactions, the system displays the updated transaction list screen showing the new page's transaction records along with the updated page number and current date/time in the header.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Updated Transaction List Screen with New Page Data

acceptance_criteria.Given: The new page of transactions has been loaded, the page number has been incremented, and the file browse has been closed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the transaction list screen to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the updated transaction list screen (COTRN0A from mapset COTRN00) showing: up to 10 transaction rows with Transaction ID, Date (MM/DD/YY), Description, and Amount; the updated page number; current system date and time in the header; and the Transaction ID input field cleared (set to spaces)

key_functionalities.title: Backward Page Navigation (PF7)
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Presses PF7])
    B{Is First Transaction ID\nof Current Page Available?}
    C[Use First Transaction ID\nas Backward Browse Starting Point]
    D[Start from Beginning\nof Transaction File]
    E{Current Page\nNumber > 1?}
    F[Display Message:\nYou are already at the\ntop of the page]
    G[Re-display Current\nTransaction List Screen]
    H[Open Transaction File\nBrowsing Backward from\nStarting Transaction ID]
    I[Clear All 10\nTransaction Display Rows]
    J[Read Previous Transaction Records\nUp to 10 Records Backward]
    K{More Records\nAvailable?}
    L[Populate Row with\nTransaction ID, Date,\nDescription, Amount]
    M{10 Rows Filled\nor No More Records?}
    N[Attempt to Read\nOne More Previous Record]
    O{Previous Record\nFound?}
    P[Decrement Page Number\nby 1]
    Q[Set Page Number to 1]
    R[Close Transaction\nFile Browse]
    S[Display Updated\nTransaction List Screen\nwith Previous Page Data]
    AN([End])

    A --> B
    B -->|First Tran ID Available| C
    B -->|No First Tran ID| D
    C --> E
    D --> E
    E -->|Page = 1| F
    F --> G
    G --> AN
    E -->|Page > 1| H
    H --> I
    I --> J
    J --> K
    K -->|Record Found| L
    L --> M
    M -->|Continue Reading| J
    K -->|No More Records| M
    M -->|Done| N
    N --> O
    O -->|Previous Record Exists\nand Page > 1| P
    O -->|No Previous Record\nor Page = 1| Q
    P --> R
    Q --> R
    R --> S
    S --> AN

rules.rule_name: Determine Backward Browse Starting Point Based on First Transaction ID Availability
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF7 to navigate backward, the system determines the starting point for the backward browse based on whether the first transaction ID of the current page is available.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is First Transaction ID of Current Page Available?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the current page has been previously loaded
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the first transaction ID stored from the current page is blank or empty, the system sets the browse starting point to the beginning of the transaction file (lowest available transaction); otherwise, the system uses the stored first transaction ID of the current page as the backward browse starting point

rules.rule_name: Set Next-Page Availability Indicator When Navigating Backward
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF7, the system marks that a next page is available before attempting backward navigation, ensuring forward navigation (PF8) remains enabled after going back.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use First Transaction ID as Backward Browse Starting Point

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 to navigate to the previous page and the browse starting point has been determined
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares for backward page navigation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the next-page-available indicator to YES, confirming that forward navigation will be possible from the previous page

rules.rule_name: Prevent Backward Navigation When Already on First Page
rules.rule_description: The system prevents the user from navigating backward when they are already on the first page of the transaction list, displaying an informational message instead.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Current Page Number > 1?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the current page number is 1
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system does not perform any backward navigation, displays the message 'You are already at the top of the page...' on the screen, and re-displays the current transaction list without erasing the screen content

rules.rule_name: Allow Backward Navigation When Not on First Page
rules.rule_description: The system allows backward navigation and initiates the process to retrieve the previous page of transactions when the current page number is greater than 1.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Current Page Number > 1?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the current page number is greater than 1
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system proceeds to open the transaction file and retrieve the previous page of transactions starting from the determined browse starting point

rules.rule_name: Open Transaction File for Backward Browse from Starting Transaction ID
rules.rule_description: The system opens a browse session on the transaction file positioned at the determined starting transaction ID to enable sequential backward reading of transaction records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Open Transaction File Browsing Backward from Starting Transaction ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The backward browse starting point (transaction ID) has been determined and the current page number is greater than 1
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates backward page navigation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system opens a browse session on the transaction file positioned at the starting transaction ID; if the transaction ID is not found in the file, the system sets the end-of-file indicator and displays the message 'You are at the top of the page...'; if the file cannot be accessed, the system displays the message 'Unable to lookup transaction...'

rules.rule_name: Skip Current Record Before Reading Previous Records on PF7
rules.rule_description: When navigating backward via PF7, the system skips the record at the current browse position before reading the previous page records, to avoid re-displaying the first record of the current page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Open Transaction File Browsing Backward from Starting Transaction ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction file browse session has been opened at the starting transaction ID for backward navigation
acceptance_criteria.When: The key pressed is not ENTER and not PF8 (i.e., it is PF7)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads and discards one record in the backward direction before beginning to populate the display rows, effectively moving the browse cursor past the current starting record

rules.rule_name: Clear All 10 Transaction Display Rows Before Populating Previous Page
rules.rule_description: Before populating the transaction list with the previous page's data, the system clears all 10 display rows to remove any previously displayed transaction information.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear All 10 Transaction Display Rows

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction file browse session is open and no end-of-file condition or error has been encountered
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is about to populate the transaction list with the previous page of records
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system clears all 10 transaction display rows by setting Transaction ID, Transaction Date, Transaction Description, and Transaction Amount to spaces for each of the 10 rows (rows 1 through 10)

rules.rule_name: Read Up to 10 Previous Transaction Records and Populate Display Rows
rules.rule_description: The system reads transaction records in reverse order from the transaction file, populating display rows from row 10 down to row 1, until either 10 records have been read or no more records are available.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Previous Transaction Records Up to 10 Records Backward

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction file browse session is open, all 10 display rows have been cleared, and the row index is set to 10
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads previous transaction records from the transaction file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads records one at a time in reverse order; for each successfully read record, it populates the corresponding display row (starting at row 10 and decrementing to row 1) with the Transaction ID, Transaction Date (formatted as MM/DD/YY), Transaction Description, and Transaction Amount; the process continues until 10 rows are filled or no more previous records exist; if the end of file is reached, the system sets the end-of-file indicator and displays the message 'You have reached the top of the page...'; if the file cannot be read, the system displays the message 'Unable to lookup transaction...'

rules.rule_name: Populate Individual Transaction Row with ID, Date, Description and Amount
rules.rule_description: For each transaction record read during backward navigation, the system maps the transaction data fields to the correct display row on the transaction list screen, including formatting the transaction date.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Row with Transaction ID, Date, Description, Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully read from the transaction file during backward navigation and the current row index is between 1 and 10
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the transaction display row corresponding to the current row index
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system places the Transaction ID, Transaction Date (converted from the original timestamp to MM/DD/YY format using the last 2 digits of the year), Transaction Description, and Transaction Amount into the display fields of the row matching the current index (1 through 10); additionally, when populating row 1, the Transaction ID is also saved as the first transaction ID of the page; when populating row 10, the Transaction ID is also saved as the last transaction ID of the page

rules.rule_name: Determine Correct Page Number After Backward Navigation
rules.rule_description: After filling the display rows with previous page records, the system attempts to read one more previous record to determine whether there are more pages before the current view, and adjusts the page number accordingly.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Previous Record Found?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has finished populating the transaction display rows with up to 10 records during backward navigation and no error condition exists
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to read one additional previous record from the transaction file to check for more preceding pages
acceptance_criteria.Then: If an additional previous record is found AND the next-page indicator is YES AND the current page number is greater than 1, the system decrements the page number by 1; if no additional previous record is found OR the current page number is 1, the system sets the page number to 1, indicating the user is now on the first page

rules.rule_name: Close Transaction File Browse and Display Updated Transaction List
rules.rule_description: After completing the backward page data retrieval and page number determination, the system closes the transaction file browse session and displays the updated transaction list screen with the previous page data and updated page number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Close Transaction File Browse

acceptance_criteria.Given: The backward page navigation has completed, all display rows have been populated, and the page number has been updated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system finalizes the backward navigation process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system closes the transaction file browse session, updates the page number displayed on the screen with the newly calculated page number, and displays the transaction list screen showing the previous page of transactions with the current date, current time, and all populated transaction rows

key_functionalities.title: Top
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Presses PF7\nBackward Navigation])
    B{Is Current Page\nNumber Greater Than 1?}
    C[Set Starting Point to\nFirst Transaction ID\non Current Page]
    D[Proceed with\nBackward Page Navigation]
    E[Display Message:\n'You are already at the\ntop of the page...']
    F[Refresh Current Screen\nwith Boundary Message\nNo Page Change]
    G([User Remains on\nPage 1 - No Navigation])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - Page > 1\nNavigation Allowed| C
    C --> D
    B -->|No - Already on Page 1\nNavigation Blocked| E
    E --> F
    F --> G

rules.rule_name: Backward Navigation Allowed When Not on First Page
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF7 to navigate backward through the transaction list, the system evaluates whether the current page number is greater than 1 to determine if backward navigation is permitted.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Current Page Number Greater Than 1?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the current page number is tracked in the session context
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page of transactions
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system checks the current page number: if the page number is greater than 1, backward navigation is permitted and the system proceeds to load the previous page; if the page number is 1 or less, backward navigation is blocked and a boundary message is displayed

rules.rule_name: Set Starting Point to First Transaction ID for Backward Navigation
rules.rule_description: When backward navigation is permitted (current page is greater than 1), the system sets the transaction file browse starting point to the first transaction ID that was displayed on the current page, ensuring the previous page is retrieved relative to the current page's top record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Starting Point to First Transaction ID on Current Page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on a transaction list page with a page number greater than 1, and the first transaction ID of the current page is stored in the session context (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 and the system confirms backward navigation is allowed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the transaction browse starting key (TRAN-ID) to the first transaction ID recorded on the current page (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST); if the first transaction ID is blank or null, the starting key is set to LOW-VALUES (beginning of file); the next-page indicator is set to YES to confirm a previous page exists

rules.rule_name: Proceed with Backward Page Navigation
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF7 and the current page is greater than 1, the system invokes the backward page navigation process to retrieve and display the previous page of transactions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Proceed with Backward Page Navigation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on a transaction list page with page number greater than 1, and the starting transaction ID has been set to the first transaction ID of the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The system confirms backward navigation is permitted and the starting point has been established
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system executes the backward page navigation process (PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD) to retrieve up to 10 transactions preceding the current page's first record and display them on the transaction list screen

rules.rule_name: Display Top-of-List Boundary Message When Already on First Page
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to navigate backward using PF7 but is already on the first page of the transaction list, the system displays a boundary message informing the user they cannot navigate further backward.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Message: 'You are already at the top of the page...'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the current page number is 1 (the first page of results)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to a previous page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error/informational message to 'You are already at the top of the page...' and proceeds to refresh the current screen displaying this message to the user

rules.rule_name: Refresh Current Screen with Boundary Message Without Erasing
rules.rule_description: When the user is blocked from backward navigation because they are already on page 1, the system refreshes the transaction list screen displaying the boundary message while preserving the current screen content (no full screen erase), and the page number remains unchanged.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Refresh Current Screen with Boundary Message No Page Change

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on page 1 of the transaction list and has pressed PF7, and the boundary message 'You are already at the top of the page...' has been set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to redisplay the transaction list screen after blocking backward navigation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sends the transaction list screen (COTRN0A in mapset COTRN00) with the boundary message displayed in the message area, without erasing the existing screen content (SEND-ERASE is set to NO), the current page number remains unchanged at 1, and the cursor is positioned on the Transaction ID input field

rules.rule_name: User Remains on Page 1 with No Navigation Occurring
rules.rule_description: When backward navigation is blocked because the user is already on the first page, no page change occurs, the transaction list content remains the same, and the user stays on page 1 of the transaction list.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: User Remains on Page 1 - No Navigation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on page 1 of the transaction list and has pressed PF7
acceptance_criteria.When: The system has displayed the boundary message 'You are already at the top of the page...' and refreshed the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The page number remains at 1 with no decrement, the transaction records currently displayed on screen remain unchanged, the user stays on the Transaction List screen, and no backward navigation to a previous page takes place

key_functionalities.title: Bottom
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Presses PF8\nForward Navigation Request])
    B{Is Next Page\nAvailable?\nNext-Page-YES flag set?}
    C[Proceed with\nForward Page Loading]
    D[16: Bottom-of-List Boundary\nDisplay Message:\n'You are already at the\nbottom of the page...']
    E[Re-display Current\nTransaction List Screen\nwithout changes]
    F([User Remains on\nCurrent Page])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - Next Page Exists| C
    B -->|No - Already at Last Page| D
    D --> E
    E --> F

rules.rule_name: Forward Navigation Availability Check on PF8
rules.rule_description: When a user requests to navigate forward through the transaction list by pressing PF8, the system must first verify whether additional transactions exist beyond the current page before proceeding with forward page loading.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Next Page Available? Next-Page-YES flag set?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the system has previously determined and stored whether a next page of transactions exists (Next-Page-YES or Next-Page-NO indicator) based on the last page load operation
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF8 to navigate forward to the next page of transactions
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system evaluates the Next-Page-Available indicator: if the indicator is set to YES (more transactions exist beyond the current page), the system proceeds with loading and displaying the next page of transactions; if the indicator is set to NO (no more transactions exist beyond the current page), the system does not attempt to load a new page and instead triggers the bottom-of-list boundary message flow

rules.rule_name: Bottom-of-List Boundary Message Display
rules.rule_description: When a user attempts to navigate forward past the last available page of transactions, the system must inform the user that no further forward navigation is possible by displaying a specific boundary message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 16: Bottom-of-List Boundary Display Message: 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the Next-Page-Available indicator is set to NO, meaning the current page is the last page of available transactions
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF8 attempting to navigate to a next page of transactions
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the message field to 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' and prepares to re-display the current transaction list screen without any changes to the displayed transaction data

rules.rule_name: Current Page Preservation at Bottom Boundary
rules.rule_description: When a user has reached the last page of the transaction list and attempts to navigate further forward, the system must preserve and re-display the current page content unchanged, without erasing or refreshing the screen data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Re-display Current Transaction List Screen without changes

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the last page of the transaction list, the Next-Page-Available indicator is NO, and the boundary message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' has been set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system re-displays the Transaction List screen after the bottom boundary condition is detected
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system re-displays the Transaction List screen with the Send-Erase flag set to NO (screen is not erased/cleared), preserving all currently displayed transaction rows (Transaction ID, Date, Description, Amount for rows 1 through 10), the current page number remains unchanged, and the boundary message is shown to the user; the user remains on the same page with no data changes

key_functionalities.title: Forward Page Data Loading
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Forward Page Data Loading])
    B[Open Browse on TRANSACT File\nStarting from given Transaction ID]
    C{Navigating from\nPF8 or New Search?}

    E[Clear All 10 Transaction\nDisplay Rows on Screen]
    F[Set Row Counter to 1]
    G{Row Counter ≤ 10\nAND More Records Exist?}

    O[Format Transaction Amount\nwith Sign and Decimal]

    R{Were any records\nloaded onto page?}

    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G
    G -->|Yes| H
    H --> I

    J -->|Yes Row 1| K
    K --> L

    N --> O
    O --> P
    P --> Q
    Q --> G

    R -->|Yes, records loaded| S
    S --> T

    T -->|No| V
    U --> W
    V --> W

    W --> X
