Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The formatted time in HH:MM:SS format (WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS) is placed into the Current Time field (CURTIMEO) of the Transaction List screen output map (COTRN0AO), completing the screen header population

all_rules.Rule_Name: Place Formatted Time HH:MM:SS onto Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The formatted current time in HH:MM:SS format must be displayed in the current time field of the Transaction List screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen (MAP: COTRN0A, MAPSET: COTRN00) and has pressed a function key to submit the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system receives the screen submission
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All input fields entered by the user on the screen are captured into the input map structure COTRN0AI, including selection flags (SEL0001I–SEL0010I), transaction IDs (TRNID01I–TRNID10I), the transaction ID search criteria field (TRNIDINI), and the current page number field (PAGENUMI), making all values available for business processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture All Screen Input Fields from Transaction List Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user submits the transaction list screen by pressing a function key, all input fields from the screen are captured into the input map COTRN0AI in a single operation, making them available for subsequent processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen displays up to 10 transaction rows, each with a corresponding selection flag input field (SEL0001I through SEL0010I)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits the screen after optionally entering a value in one or more selection flag fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures all 10 selection flag fields (SEL0001I through SEL0010I) from the screen into the input map COTRN0AI, preserving the value entered by the user in each row's selection field for subsequent validation and action processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Transaction Row Selection Flags from Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system captures one selection flag field per transaction row (up to 10 rows) from the screen input. Each selection flag corresponds to a specific transaction row and indicates whether the user has marked that transaction for an action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen displays up to 10 transaction rows, each showing a Transaction ID (TRNID01I through TRNID10I) corresponding to a transaction record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures all 10 Transaction ID fields (TRNID01I through TRNID10I) from the screen into the input map COTRN0AI, so that when a selection flag is set for a row, the corresponding Transaction ID is available to identify the selected transaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Transaction ID Fields for Each Displayed Row
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system captures the Transaction ID associated with each of the up to 10 displayed transaction rows from the screen. These IDs are used to identify which specific transaction the user has selected for further action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen contains a Transaction ID search criteria input field (TRNIDINI) where the user can optionally enter a numeric Transaction ID to filter or position the list
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits the screen with or without a value in the Transaction ID search criteria field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the value from the Transaction ID search criteria field (TRNIDINI) into the input map COTRN0AI; if the field is blank or contains low-values, it is treated as no search criteria; if it contains a value, it will be subject to numeric validation before being used to position the transaction list

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Transaction ID Search Criteria Field
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system captures the Transaction ID search/filter value entered by the user in the search criteria field (TRNIDINI). This value is used to position the transaction list starting from a specific Transaction ID.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is navigating through the Transaction List screen and the current page number is tracked in the communication area field CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM and displayed on screen as PAGENUMI
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits the screen by pressing a function key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the current page number from the screen input map COTRN0AI (PAGENUMI field) and retains it in the communication area (CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM) so that pagination logic can correctly determine whether to navigate forward or backward, and whether the user is already at the first or last page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Current Page Number for Pagination Tracking
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system retains and tracks the current page number across screen interactions to support forward and backward pagination through the transaction list. The page number is maintained in the communication area and reflected on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and has optionally entered a selection indicator next to a transaction row and/or a Transaction ID in the search field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the ENTER key to submit their input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system routes control to the selection and search processing logic, which evaluates any row selections (S/s) and the Transaction ID search field to determine the appropriate next action

all_rules.Rule_Name: Route ENTER Key to Selection and Search Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses the ENTER key on the Transaction List screen, the system routes processing to handle any transaction row selections and/or transaction ID search criteria entered by the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the Main Menu (COMEN01C) and transfers control to that screen, exiting the Transaction List

all_rules.Rule_Name: Route PF3 Key to Return to Main Menu
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF3 on the Transaction List screen, the system navigates the user back to the Main Menu screen, exiting the transaction list.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen viewing a page of transactions
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the PF7 key to scroll to the previous page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system routes control to the backward page navigation processing logic to retrieve and display the previous set of up to 10 transactions

all_rules.Rule_Name: Route PF7 Key to Previous Page Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF7 on the Transaction List screen, the system routes processing to the backward page navigation logic to display the previous page of transactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen viewing a page of transactions
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the PF8 key to scroll to the next page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system routes control to the forward page navigation processing logic to retrieve and display the next set of up to 10 transactions

all_rules.Rule_Name: Route PF8 Key to Next Page Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF8 on the Transaction List screen, the system routes processing to the forward page navigation logic to display the next page of transactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF7, or PF8 (e.g., PF1, PF2, PF4, PF5, PF6, PF9, PA keys, etc.)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', positions the cursor on the Transaction ID input field, displays the standard invalid key error message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) at the bottom of the screen, and redisplays the Transaction List screen without changing any displayed transaction data

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reject and Report Invalid Function Key Press
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF7, or PF8 on the Transaction List screen, the system treats it as an invalid action, sets an error condition, and redisplays the current Transaction List screen with an invalid key error message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, and the user has interacted with the screen by pressing ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The selection field for Row 1 (SEL0001I) contains a value that is neither blank nor empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the selection indicator entered by the user from Row 1 into the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG), and captures the Transaction ID displayed in Row 1 (TRNID01I) into the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED), and no further rows are evaluated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Capture Row 1 Transaction Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters a selection value in the first row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 1 for further processing. Row 1 is evaluated first and takes priority over all other rows.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, the user has pressed ENTER, and the selection field for Row 1 (SEL0001I) is blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The selection field for Row 2 (SEL0002I) contains a value that is neither blank nor empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the selection indicator entered by the user from Row 2 into the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG), and captures the Transaction ID displayed in Row 2 (TRNID02I) into the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED), and no further rows are evaluated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Capture Row 2 Transaction Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When Row 1 has no selection and the user enters a selection value in the second row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 2.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, the user has pressed ENTER, and the selection fields for Rows 1 (SEL0001I) and 2 (SEL0002I) are both blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The selection field for Row 3 (SEL0003I) contains a value that is neither blank nor empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the selection indicator entered by the user from Row 3 into the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG), and captures the Transaction ID displayed in Row 3 (TRNID03I) into the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED), and no further rows are evaluated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Capture Row 3 Transaction Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When Rows 1 and 2 have no selection and the user enters a selection value in the third row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 3.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, the user has pressed ENTER, and the selection fields for Rows 1 (SEL0001I), 2 (SEL0002I), and 3 (SEL0003I) are all blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The selection field for Row 4 (SEL0004I) contains a value that is neither blank nor empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the selection indicator entered by the user from Row 4 into the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG), and captures the Transaction ID displayed in Row 4 (TRNID04I) into the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED), and no further rows are evaluated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Capture Row 4 Transaction Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When Rows 1 through 3 have no selection and the user enters a selection value in the fourth row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 4.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, the user has pressed ENTER, and the selection fields for Rows 1 (SEL0001I) through 4 (SEL0004I) are all blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The selection field for Row 5 (SEL0005I) contains a value that is neither blank nor empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the selection indicator entered by the user from Row 5 into the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG), and captures the Transaction ID displayed in Row 5 (TRNID05I) into the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED), and no further rows are evaluated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Capture Row 5 Transaction Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When Rows 1 through 4 have no selection and the user enters a selection value in the fifth row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 5.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, the user has pressed ENTER, and the selection fields for Rows 1 (SEL0001I) through 5 (SEL0005I) are all blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The selection field for Row 6 (SEL0006I) contains a value that is neither blank nor empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the selection indicator entered by the user from Row 6 into the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG), and captures the Transaction ID displayed in Row 6 (TRNID06I) into the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED), and no further rows are evaluated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Capture Row 6 Transaction Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When Rows 1 through 5 have no selection and the user enters a selection value in the sixth row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 6.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, the user has pressed ENTER, and the selection fields for Rows 1 (SEL0001I) through 6 (SEL0006I) are all blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The selection field for Row 7 (SEL0007I) contains a value that is neither blank nor empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the selection indicator entered by the user from Row 7 into the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG), and captures the Transaction ID displayed in Row 7 (TRNID07I) into the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED), and no further rows are evaluated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Capture Row 7 Transaction Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When Rows 1 through 6 have no selection and the user enters a selection value in the seventh row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 7.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, the user has pressed ENTER, and the selection fields for Rows 1 (SEL0001I) through 7 (SEL0007I) are all blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The selection field for Row 8 (SEL0008I) contains a value that is neither blank nor empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the selection indicator entered by the user from Row 8 into the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG), and captures the Transaction ID displayed in Row 8 (TRNID08I) into the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED), and no further rows are evaluated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Capture Row 8 Transaction Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When Rows 1 through 7 have no selection and the user enters a selection value in the eighth row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 8.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, the user has pressed ENTER, and the selection fields for Rows 1 (SEL0001I) through 8 (SEL0008I) are all blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The selection field for Row 9 (SEL0009I) contains a value that is neither blank nor empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the selection indicator entered by the user from Row 9 into the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG), and captures the Transaction ID displayed in Row 9 (TRNID09I) into the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED), and no further rows are evaluated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Capture Row 9 Transaction Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When Rows 1 through 8 have no selection and the user enters a selection value in the ninth row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 9.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, the user has pressed ENTER, and the selection fields for Rows 1 (SEL0001I) through 9 (SEL0009I) are all blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The selection field for Row 10 (SEL0010I) contains a value that is neither blank nor empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the selection indicator entered by the user from Row 10 into the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG), and captures the Transaction ID displayed in Row 10 (TRNID10I) into the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED), and no further rows are evaluated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Capture Row 10 Transaction Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When Rows 1 through 9 have no selection and the user enters a selection value in the tenth and final row of the transaction list, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding Transaction ID from Row 10.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows and the user has pressed ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.When: All selection fields from Row 1 (SEL0001I) through Row 10 (SEL0010I) are blank or empty (SPACES or LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system clears the active selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG) to SPACES and clears the selected transaction identifier (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED) to SPACES, indicating no transaction was selected, and processing continues to the Transaction ID search and page display logic

all_rules.Rule_Name: No Transaction Row Selected – Clear Selection State
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses ENTER without entering any selection value in any of the 10 transaction rows, the system clears the active selection flag and the selected transaction identifier, indicating that no transaction has been chosen for further action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displaying up to 10 transaction rows, each with a selection input field (SEL0001 through SEL0010) and a corresponding Transaction ID (TRNID01 through TRNID10)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and one or more selection fields contain a non-blank, non-null value
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system scans rows 1 through 10 sequentially and captures the selection value and the corresponding Transaction ID from the FIRST row that contains a non-blank, non-null selection entry; all other selection entries are ignored

all_rules.Rule_Name: Scan Transaction Rows to Identify User Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system scans all 10 transaction rows displayed on the Transaction List screen from top to bottom and identifies the first row where the user has entered a selection value. Only the first non-blank, non-null selection entry is processed; all subsequent entries are ignored.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displayed with up to 10 transaction rows, each having an empty selection field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and all 10 selection fields (SEL0001 through SEL0010) are blank or null
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system clears both the selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG) and the selected Transaction ID (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED) to spaces, and continues processing the screen without navigating to any detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: No Transaction Row Selected by User
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses ENTER without entering any selection value in any of the 10 transaction rows, the system clears the selection context and continues processing the screen without attempting any transaction detail navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has scanned the 10 transaction rows and found the first row (any of rows 1 through 10) where the selection field contains a non-blank, non-null value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A selected row is identified
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system stores the selection value from that row's selection field into the selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG) and stores the Transaction ID from that same row (TRNID01 through TRNID10 corresponding to the selected row) into the selected Transaction ID field (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Selection Value and Transaction ID from Selected Row
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a row with a non-blank selection entry is identified, the system captures both the selection value entered by the user and the Transaction ID associated with that row for subsequent validation and navigation processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction row has been selected with a non-blank selection value captured in CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG and a non-blank Transaction ID captured in CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the captured selection value
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The selection is considered valid only if the value is exactly 'S' (uppercase) or 's' (lowercase); any other value is treated as an invalid selection

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Transaction Selection Value Must Be 'S'
all_rules.Rule_Description: The only valid value a user may enter in a transaction row's selection field is the letter 'S' (uppercase or lowercase). Any other non-blank value entered in the selection field is considered invalid and will not trigger navigation to the Transaction Detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction row has been selected and the captured selection value in CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG is not 'S' and not 's' (i.e., it is any other non-blank value)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the selection value and determines it is invalid
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' on the Transaction List screen and keeps the user on the current screen without navigating to any detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invalid Selection Value – Display Error Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters a selection value other than 'S' or 's' in any transaction row's selection field, the system rejects the selection and displays an error message informing the user of the only valid selection value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid selection value of 'S' or 's' next to a transaction row, and both the selection flag (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG) and the selected Transaction ID (CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED) are non-blank
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to navigate to the Transaction Detail screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to 'COTRN01C', records the current transaction identifier (WS-TRANID) as the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), records the current program name (WS-PGMNAME) as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), and sets the program context indicator (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT) to 0

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Navigation Context Before Transferring to Transaction Detail
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before transferring control to the Transaction Detail screen, the system establishes the full navigation context by recording the destination program, the originating transaction identifier, the originating program name, and resetting the program context indicator to ensure the detail screen initializes correctly.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The navigation context has been set with destination program 'COTRN01C', the originating transaction ID, the originating program name, and program context set to 0, and the communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) contains the selected Transaction ID in CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the transfer of control
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system transfers full control to the Transaction Detail program 'COTRN01C' passing the complete communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA); the current Transaction List program ceases execution and the Transaction Detail screen takes over

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transfer Control to Transaction Detail Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user selects a transaction using 'S' or 's' and the navigation context has been established, the system transfers full control to the Transaction Detail screen (COTRN01C), passing the complete session communication area including the selected Transaction ID, so the detail screen can display the full details of the chosen transaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction List screen is displaying up to 10 transaction rows, each with a selection input field (SEL0001 through SEL0010) and a corresponding Transaction ID (TRNID01 through TRNID10)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and the system evaluates each selection field from row 1 to row 10 sequentially
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If any selection field (SEL0001 through SEL0010) contains a value that is not spaces and not low-values, the system captures that selection flag value and the corresponding Transaction ID from that row into the active selection context; if no selection field contains a non-blank value, the selection flag and selected Transaction ID are both cleared to spaces and processing continues to the Transaction ID search step

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Transaction Row Selection Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system scans all 10 transaction rows on the Transaction List screen from top to bottom to determine whether the user has entered a selection value in any row's selection field. The first row (1 through 10) containing a non-blank, non-null value is treated as the user's selection. Only one selection is processed per screen interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a non-blank value in one of the 10 transaction row selection fields on the Transaction List screen, and the system has captured that selection value and the corresponding Transaction ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the captured selection flag value
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the selection value is 'S' or 's', the system proceeds to navigate to the Transaction Detail screen; if the selection value is anything other than 'S' or 's', the system sets the error message to 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' and re-displays the Transaction List screen with the error message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Transaction Selection Value is 'S'
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters a value in a transaction row's selection field, the system validates that the entered value is exactly 'S' (uppercase) or 's' (lowercase). Any other value is considered invalid and triggers an error message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered 'S' or 's' in a selection field next to a transaction row, and the system has validated the selection value and confirmed the selected Transaction ID is non-blank
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the valid selection
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to 'COTRN01C' (Transaction Detail screen), records the current transaction name and program name as the originating context, resets the program context to 0, and transfers control to the Transaction Detail screen passing the full session communication area including the selected Transaction ID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Navigate to Transaction Detail Screen on Valid Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user selects a transaction using the valid selection value 'S' or 's', the system transfers control to the Transaction Detail screen, passing the selected Transaction ID and current session context so the user can view the full details of the chosen transaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a value in a transaction row selection field that is not 'S' and not 's' (e.g., 'X', 'D', '1', or any other character)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the selection value and determines it is not a valid selection indicator
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error message to 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' and positions the cursor on the Transaction ID input field, then re-displays the Transaction List screen showing the error message to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Error Message for Invalid Selection Value
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters a selection value other than 'S' or 's' in any transaction row selection field, the system must inform the user of the valid selection option by displaying a specific error message on the Transaction List screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has set the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' due to an invalid selection entry, and the cursor has been positioned on the Transaction ID input field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the Transaction List screen back to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction List screen is re-displayed with the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' shown in the message area, the existing transaction list data remains on screen, and processing continues to the Transaction ID search validation step without navigating away from the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Re-display Transaction List Screen After Invalid Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: After detecting an invalid selection value, the system re-displays the Transaction List screen with the error message visible, allowing the user to correct their selection. The screen is sent without erasing the existing content so the current transaction list remains visible.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed evaluation of all selection fields — either no selection was made, a valid selection navigated to detail screen, or an invalid selection displayed an error message
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Selection processing is complete (for the invalid or no-selection paths)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system proceeds to evaluate the Transaction ID search input field: if blank, the list starts from the beginning of the transaction file; if numeric, the list starts from that Transaction ID; if non-numeric, an error message 'Tran ID must be Numeric...' is displayed and the screen is re-shown

all_rules.Rule_Name: Continue to Transaction ID Search After Selection Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: Regardless of whether a selection was made (valid, invalid, or absent), the system always continues to process the Transaction ID search field after completing selection validation. This ensures the transaction list is refreshed or filtered based on any Transaction ID the user may have entered.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and the Transaction ID search input field contains only spaces or is empty (blank/null value)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses ENTER to initiate a transaction search
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the internal transaction search key to the lowest possible value (beginning of file), so that the transaction list is loaded starting from the very first available transaction record, and processing continues to load and display the transaction list

all_rules.Rule_Name: Blank Transaction ID Search Field Defaults to Beginning of Transaction List
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user leaves the Transaction ID search field empty on the Transaction List screen and presses ENTER, the system treats the search as starting from the very beginning of the transaction file, effectively retrieving transactions from the first available record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and has entered a non-blank value in the Transaction ID search input field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and the entered Transaction ID value contains only numeric digits
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system accepts the entered Transaction ID as a valid search key, stores it as the transaction file search position key, and continues to load and display the transaction list starting from that Transaction ID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Numeric Transaction ID Search Value Accepted as Valid Search Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters a value in the Transaction ID search field, the system validates that the entered value is numeric. If the value is numeric, it is accepted as a valid search key and used to position the transaction list starting from that Transaction ID.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and has entered a non-blank value in the Transaction ID search input field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and the entered Transaction ID value contains non-numeric characters (letters, special characters, or alphanumeric mix)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y' (ON), sets the error message to 'Tran ID must be Numeric...', positions the cursor on the Transaction ID input field, re-displays the Transaction List screen showing the error message, and halts further transaction search processing — awaiting user correction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Non-Numeric Transaction ID Search Value Rejected with Error Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters a non-numeric value in the Transaction ID search field, the system rejects the input, sets an error condition, displays the error message 'Tran ID must be Numeric...', positions the cursor back on the Transaction ID field, and re-displays the Transaction List screen so the user can correct the entry. No transaction search is performed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and has submitted the screen by pressing ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction ID search field is left blank (contains spaces or no value)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the internal search key to the lowest possible value, ensuring the transaction list browse starts from the very first available transaction record in the system

all_rules.Rule_Name: Blank Transaction ID Defaults to Beginning of Transaction List
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user leaves the Transaction ID search field empty, the system automatically sets the search starting point to the lowest possible value so that the transaction list is retrieved from the very beginning of the available records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and has submitted the screen by pressing ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction ID search field contains a non-blank, numeric value
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system uses the entered Transaction ID as the search key to start browsing the transaction file, so the transaction list is displayed beginning from that specific Transaction ID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Valid Numeric Transaction ID Used as Search Starting Point
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters a numeric Transaction ID in the search field, the system uses that value as the starting point for browsing the transaction list, displaying records from that transaction onwards.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and has submitted the screen by pressing ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction ID search field contains a non-blank value that is not numeric
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Tran ID must be Numeric ...' on the Transaction List screen, positions the cursor on the Transaction ID field, and does not proceed to load any transaction records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Non-Numeric Transaction ID Entry is Rejected
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters a non-numeric value in the Transaction ID search field, the system rejects the input, displays a validation error message, and keeps the user on the Transaction List screen without performing any search.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction ID search field has been validated and the search key has been set (either to the entered Transaction ID or to the lowest possible value)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is about to retrieve and display the transaction list
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system resets the current page number to zero and then initiates the forward page loading process to populate and display the first page of the transaction list

all_rules.Rule_Name: Page Counter Reset Before Loading Transaction List
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the Transaction ID search key has been established (either from user input or defaulted to the beginning), the page counter is always reset to zero before the forward page load is initiated, ensuring the display starts at page 1.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing a page of transactions and presses PF8 to navigate to the next page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The last transaction ID of the current page (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST) is available (not spaces and not low-values)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the transaction browse starting point (TRAN-ID) to the last transaction ID of the current page (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Starting Point When Last Transaction ID Is Available
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF8 to navigate forward, the system determines the browse starting point based on whether the last transaction ID of the current page is recorded.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and presses PF8 to navigate forward
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The last transaction ID of the current page (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST) is blank or empty (spaces or low-values)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the transaction browse starting point (TRAN-ID) to HIGH-VALUES, representing the end of the transaction file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Starting Point When Last Transaction ID Is Not Available
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF8 but no last transaction ID is recorded for the current page, the system defaults the browse starting point to the end of the transaction file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the last page of the transaction list
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF8 and the next-page indicator (NEXT-PAGE flag) is set to NO (NEXT-PAGE-YES is FALSE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' and re-displays the current transaction list screen without changing the page content

all_rules.Rule_Name: Block Forward Navigation When Already on Last Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user attempts to navigate forward but there are no more pages of transactions available, the system prevents navigation and informs the user they are already at the last page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The next-page indicator confirms more transactions are available and a starting transaction ID (TRAN-ID) has been set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system begins forward page processing (PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system opens a browse session on the transaction file (WS-TRANSACT-FILE) positioned at the specified TRAN-ID key

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Transaction File Browse from Last Transaction ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: When forward navigation is permitted, the system initiates a sequential browse of the transaction file starting at the determined transaction ID position.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The transaction file browse has been opened at the last transaction ID of the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The triggering action is PF8 (not ENTER, PF7, or PF3)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads the next transaction record (READNEXT) once to move the browse cursor past the current page's last transaction, so the new page starts with the record immediately following it

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Past the Last Transaction ID of the Current Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: After opening the browse at the last transaction ID of the current page, the system advances one record forward to skip past that already-displayed transaction before populating the new page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The browse cursor is positioned past the last transaction of the current page and the system is ready to populate the next page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system begins loading new transaction records for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system clears all 10 transaction rows on the screen by setting Transaction ID, Transaction Date, Transaction Description, and Transaction Amount fields (rows 1 through 10: TRNID01I–TRNID10I, TDATE01I–TDATE10I, TDESC01I–TDESC10I, TAMT001I–TAMT010I) to spaces

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Transaction Display Rows Before Populating New Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before populating the screen with new transaction data, all 10 transaction display rows are cleared to ensure no stale data from the previous page remains visible.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The transaction file browse is open and positioned past the last transaction of the previous page, and all 10 display rows have been cleared
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads transaction records sequentially (READNEXT) in a loop
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: For each successfully read record (up to a maximum of 10), the system populates the corresponding display row with: Transaction ID (TRAN-ID), Transaction Date formatted as MM/DD/YY (derived from TRAN-ORIG-TS), Transaction Description (TRAN-DESC), and Transaction Amount (TRAN-AMT); the loop continues until 10 rows are filled or end-of-file is reached

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read and Populate Up to 10 Transaction Records for New Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system sequentially reads transaction records from the file and populates each of the 10 display rows with transaction details until either 10 rows are filled or no more records are available.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is populating transaction rows for the new page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The first transaction record (row index WS-IDX = 1) is being populated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system stores the Transaction ID into both the first display row (TRNID01I) and the first-transaction-ID tracker (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Record First Transaction ID of New Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When populating the first row of the new page, the system records the transaction ID as the first transaction ID of the current page, enabling backward navigation (PF7) later.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is populating transaction rows for the new page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The tenth transaction record (row index WS-IDX = 10) is being populated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system stores the Transaction ID into both the last display row (TRNID10I) and the last-transaction-ID tracker (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Record Last Transaction ID of New Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When populating the tenth (last) row of the new page, the system records the transaction ID as the last transaction ID of the current page, enabling forward navigation (PF8) in subsequent interactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has finished populating the new page with up to 10 transaction records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to read one more transaction record beyond the 10 displayed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If an additional record is found, the system marks the next-page indicator as YES (NEXT-PAGE-YES = TRUE), indicating more pages are available; if no additional record is found (end-of-file), the system marks the next-page indicator as NO (NEXT-PAGE-NO = TRUE), indicating this is the last page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Check for Additional Records Beyond the New Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: After filling up to 10 transaction rows, the system attempts to read one additional record to determine whether a further next page exists, enabling or disabling the PF8 forward navigation for the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully loaded transaction records for the next page (at least one record was read, WS-IDX > 1) or all 10 rows were filled
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The forward page population loop completes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system increments the current page number (CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM) by 1 and displays the updated page number (PAGENUMI) on the transaction list screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Page Number After Successful Forward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully loading a new forward page of transactions, the system increments the page counter by 1 to reflect the user's current position in the transaction list.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed reading transaction records for the new page and has determined whether a further next page exists
Acceptance_Criteria.When: All page population processing is complete
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system closes the browse session on the transaction file (WS-TRANSACT-FILE) using ENDBR

all_rules.Rule_Name: Close Transaction File Browse After Page Load
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all transaction records for the new page have been read and the next-page indicator has been set, the system closes the transaction file browse session.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The new page of transactions has been loaded, the page number has been incremented, and the file browse has been closed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the transaction list screen to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the updated transaction list screen (COTRN0A from mapset COTRN00) showing: up to 10 transaction rows with Transaction ID, Date (MM/DD/YY), Description, and Amount; the updated page number; current system date and time in the header; and the Transaction ID input field cleared (set to spaces)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Updated Transaction List Screen with New Page Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully loading the next page of transactions, the system displays the updated transaction list screen showing the new page's transaction records along with the updated page number and current date/time in the header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the current page has been previously loaded
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the first transaction ID stored from the current page is blank or empty, the system sets the browse starting point to the beginning of the transaction file (lowest available transaction); otherwise, the system uses the stored first transaction ID of the current page as the backward browse starting point

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Backward Browse Starting Point Based on First Transaction ID Availability
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF7 to navigate backward, the system determines the starting point for the backward browse based on whether the first transaction ID of the current page is available.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 to navigate to the previous page and the browse starting point has been determined
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares for backward page navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the next-page-available indicator to YES, confirming that forward navigation will be possible from the previous page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Next-Page Availability Indicator When Navigating Backward
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF7, the system marks that a next page is available before attempting backward navigation, ensuring forward navigation (PF8) remains enabled after going back.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the current page number is 1
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system does not perform any backward navigation, displays the message 'You are already at the top of the page...' on the screen, and re-displays the current transaction list without erasing the screen content

all_rules.Rule_Name: Prevent Backward Navigation When Already on First Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system prevents the user from navigating backward when they are already on the first page of the transaction list, displaying an informational message instead.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the current page number is greater than 1
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system proceeds to open the transaction file and retrieve the previous page of transactions starting from the determined browse starting point

all_rules.Rule_Name: Allow Backward Navigation When Not on First Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system allows backward navigation and initiates the process to retrieve the previous page of transactions when the current page number is greater than 1.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The backward browse starting point (transaction ID) has been determined and the current page number is greater than 1
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates backward page navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system opens a browse session on the transaction file positioned at the starting transaction ID; if the transaction ID is not found in the file, the system sets the end-of-file indicator and displays the message 'You are at the top of the page...'; if the file cannot be accessed, the system displays the message 'Unable to lookup transaction...'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Transaction File for Backward Browse from Starting Transaction ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system opens a browse session on the transaction file positioned at the determined starting transaction ID to enable sequential backward reading of transaction records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The transaction file browse session has been opened at the starting transaction ID for backward navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The key pressed is not ENTER and not PF8 (i.e., it is PF7)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads and discards one record in the backward direction before beginning to populate the display rows, effectively moving the browse cursor past the current starting record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Current Record Before Reading Previous Records on PF7
all_rules.Rule_Description: When navigating backward via PF7, the system skips the record at the current browse position before reading the previous page records, to avoid re-displaying the first record of the current page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The transaction file browse session is open and no end-of-file condition or error has been encountered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is about to populate the transaction list with the previous page of records
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system clears all 10 transaction display rows by setting Transaction ID, Transaction Date, Transaction Description, and Transaction Amount to spaces for each of the 10 rows (rows 1 through 10)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All 10 Transaction Display Rows Before Populating Previous Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before populating the transaction list with the previous page's data, the system clears all 10 display rows to remove any previously displayed transaction information.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The transaction file browse session is open, all 10 display rows have been cleared, and the row index is set to 10
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads previous transaction records from the transaction file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads records one at a time in reverse order; for each successfully read record, it populates the corresponding display row (starting at row 10 and decrementing to row 1) with the Transaction ID, Transaction Date (formatted as MM/DD/YY), Transaction Description, and Transaction Amount; the process continues until 10 rows are filled or no more previous records exist; if the end of file is reached, the system sets the end-of-file indicator and displays the message 'You have reached the top of the page...'; if the file cannot be read, the system displays the message 'Unable to lookup transaction...'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Up to 10 Previous Transaction Records and Populate Display Rows
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system reads transaction records in reverse order from the transaction file, populating display rows from row 10 down to row 1, until either 10 records have been read or no more records are available.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully read from the transaction file during backward navigation and the current row index is between 1 and 10
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the transaction display row corresponding to the current row index
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system places the Transaction ID, Transaction Date (converted from the original timestamp to MM/DD/YY format using the last 2 digits of the year), Transaction Description, and Transaction Amount into the display fields of the row matching the current index (1 through 10); additionally, when populating row 1, the Transaction ID is also saved as the first transaction ID of the page; when populating row 10, the Transaction ID is also saved as the last transaction ID of the page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Individual Transaction Row with ID, Date, Description and Amount
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each transaction record read during backward navigation, the system maps the transaction data fields to the correct display row on the transaction list screen, including formatting the transaction date.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has finished populating the transaction display rows with up to 10 records during backward navigation and no error condition exists
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to read one additional previous record from the transaction file to check for more preceding pages
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If an additional previous record is found AND the next-page indicator is YES AND the current page number is greater than 1, the system decrements the page number by 1; if no additional previous record is found OR the current page number is 1, the system sets the page number to 1, indicating the user is now on the first page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Correct Page Number After Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: After filling the display rows with previous page records, the system attempts to read one more previous record to determine whether there are more pages before the current view, and adjusts the page number accordingly.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The backward page navigation has completed, all display rows have been populated, and the page number has been updated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system finalizes the backward navigation process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system closes the transaction file browse session, updates the page number displayed on the screen with the newly calculated page number, and displays the transaction list screen showing the previous page of transactions with the current date, current time, and all populated transaction rows

all_rules.Rule_Name: Close Transaction File Browse and Display Updated Transaction List
all_rules.Rule_Description: After completing the backward page data retrieval and page number determination, the system closes the transaction file browse session and displays the updated transaction list screen with the previous page data and updated page number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the current page number is tracked in the session context
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page of transactions
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system checks the current page number: if the page number is greater than 1, backward navigation is permitted and the system proceeds to load the previous page; if the page number is 1 or less, backward navigation is blocked and a boundary message is displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Backward Navigation Allowed When Not on First Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF7 to navigate backward through the transaction list, the system evaluates whether the current page number is greater than 1 to determine if backward navigation is permitted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on a transaction list page with a page number greater than 1, and the first transaction ID of the current page is stored in the session context (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF7 and the system confirms backward navigation is allowed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the transaction browse starting key (TRAN-ID) to the first transaction ID recorded on the current page (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST); if the first transaction ID is blank or null, the starting key is set to LOW-VALUES (beginning of file); the next-page indicator is set to YES to confirm a previous page exists

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Starting Point to First Transaction ID for Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When backward navigation is permitted (current page is greater than 1), the system sets the transaction file browse starting point to the first transaction ID that was displayed on the current page, ensuring the previous page is retrieved relative to the current page's top record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on a transaction list page with page number greater than 1, and the starting transaction ID has been set to the first transaction ID of the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system confirms backward navigation is permitted and the starting point has been established
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system executes the backward page navigation process (PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD) to retrieve up to 10 transactions preceding the current page's first record and display them on the transaction list screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Proceed with Backward Page Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF7 and the current page is greater than 1, the system invokes the backward page navigation process to retrieve and display the previous page of transactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the current page number is 1 (the first page of results)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to a previous page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error/informational message to 'You are already at the top of the page...' and proceeds to refresh the current screen displaying this message to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Top-of-List Boundary Message When Already on First Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user attempts to navigate backward using PF7 but is already on the first page of the transaction list, the system displays a boundary message informing the user they cannot navigate further backward.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on page 1 of the transaction list and has pressed PF7, and the boundary message 'You are already at the top of the page...' has been set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to redisplay the transaction list screen after blocking backward navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sends the transaction list screen (COTRN0A in mapset COTRN00) with the boundary message displayed in the message area, without erasing the existing screen content (SEND-ERASE is set to NO), the current page number remains unchanged at 1, and the cursor is positioned on the Transaction ID input field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Refresh Current Screen with Boundary Message Without Erasing
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user is blocked from backward navigation because they are already on page 1, the system refreshes the transaction list screen displaying the boundary message while preserving the current screen content (no full screen erase), and the page number remains unchanged.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on page 1 of the transaction list and has pressed PF7
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system has displayed the boundary message 'You are already at the top of the page...' and refreshed the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The page number remains at 1 with no decrement, the transaction records currently displayed on screen remain unchanged, the user stays on the Transaction List screen, and no backward navigation to a previous page takes place

all_rules.Rule_Name: User Remains on Page 1 with No Navigation Occurring
all_rules.Rule_Description: When backward navigation is blocked because the user is already on the first page, no page change occurs, the transaction list content remains the same, and the user stays on page 1 of the transaction list.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the system has previously determined and stored whether a next page of transactions exists (Next-Page-YES or Next-Page-NO indicator) based on the last page load operation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF8 to navigate forward to the next page of transactions
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system evaluates the Next-Page-Available indicator: if the indicator is set to YES (more transactions exist beyond the current page), the system proceeds with loading and displaying the next page of transactions; if the indicator is set to NO (no more transactions exist beyond the current page), the system does not attempt to load a new page and instead triggers the bottom-of-list boundary message flow

all_rules.Rule_Name: Forward Navigation Availability Check on PF8
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user requests to navigate forward through the transaction list by pressing PF8, the system must first verify whether additional transactions exist beyond the current page before proceeding with forward page loading.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction List screen and the Next-Page-Available indicator is set to NO, meaning the current page is the last page of available transactions
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF8 attempting to navigate to a next page of transactions
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the message field to 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' and prepares to re-display the current transaction list screen without any changes to the displayed transaction data

all_rules.Rule_Name: Bottom-of-List Boundary Message Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user attempts to navigate forward past the last available page of transactions, the system must inform the user that no further forward navigation is possible by displaying a specific boundary message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the last page of the transaction list, the Next-Page-Available indicator is NO, and the boundary message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' has been set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system re-displays the Transaction List screen after the bottom boundary condition is detected
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system re-displays the Transaction List screen with the Send-Erase flag set to NO (screen is not erased/cleared), preserving all currently displayed transaction rows (Transaction ID, Date, Description, Amount for rows 1 through 10), the current page number remains unchanged, and the boundary message is shown to the user; the user remains on the same page with no data changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Current Page Preservation at Bottom Boundary
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user has reached the last page of the transaction list and attempts to navigate further forward, the system must preserve and re-display the current page content unchanged, without erasing or refreshing the screen data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Transaction ID has been established as the starting point (either from a user search entry, LOW-VALUES for beginning of file, or the last Transaction ID from the current page for PF8 navigation)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates a forward page data loading operation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system opens a browse session on the TRANSACT file positioned at the given Transaction ID, enabling sequential forward reading from that position

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Transaction File Browse from Starting Transaction ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: When loading a forward page of transactions, the system opens a browse session on the Transaction file starting at the specified Transaction ID as the entry point for sequential forward reading.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A forward page data load has been initiated and the browse session is open on the TRANSACT file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The navigation was triggered by the PF8 key (forward scroll) — meaning the key pressed is NOT ENTER, NOT PF7, and NOT PF3
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads and discards the next record from the TRANSACT file (skipping the starting Transaction ID record) before beginning to populate the page, so that the starting transaction is not duplicated on the new page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Starting Record on PF8 Forward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user navigates forward using PF8, the system skips the record at the current browse position (the last transaction of the previous page) before loading new records, ensuring no duplicate transactions appear across pages.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A forward page data load has been initiated and the browse session is open on the TRANSACT file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The navigation was triggered by the ENTER key, PF7 key, or PF3 key (i.e., not a PF8 forward scroll)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system does NOT skip any record and proceeds directly to clearing the display rows and loading transactions from the current browse position

all_rules.Rule_Name: Load New Page Without Skipping on ENTER or New Search
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user initiates a new transaction search by pressing ENTER (including the initial program load), the system does not skip any record and begins loading transactions directly from the browse starting position.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A forward page data load is in progress and the skip-record step (if applicable) has been completed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is about to begin reading and populating transaction records onto the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All 10 transaction display rows are cleared — each row's Transaction ID, Transaction Date, Transaction Description, and Transaction Amount fields are set to spaces before any new data is loaded

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Transaction Display Rows Before Loading
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before populating the transaction list page with new data, all 10 transaction display rows on the screen are cleared to spaces, ensuring no stale data from a previous page remains visible.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The transaction display rows have been cleared and the row counter is set to 1
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row counter is less than or equal to 10 AND the end of the transaction file has not been reached AND no error condition exists
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads the next transaction record sequentially forward from the TRANSACT file and attempts to populate it into the current row position on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Sequential Forward Reading of Up to 10 Transaction Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system reads transaction records sequentially forward from the TRANSACT file, one at a time, continuing until either 10 records have been successfully loaded onto the page or no more records exist in the file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully read from the TRANSACT file during forward page loading
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current row counter equals 1 (i.e., this is the first transaction being placed on the page)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction ID of this record is stored as the First Transaction ID of the current page (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST), in addition to being placed into the first row of the screen display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture First Transaction ID of the Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction ID of the first record loaded onto the page is captured and stored as the page's first Transaction ID, which is used as the reference point for backward navigation (PF7) to return to this page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully read from the TRANSACT file during forward page loading
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current row counter equals 10 (i.e., this is the tenth and final transaction being placed on the page)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction ID of this record is stored as the Last Transaction ID of the current page (CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST), in addition to being placed into the tenth row of the screen display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Last Transaction ID of the Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction ID of the tenth (last) record loaded onto the page is captured and stored as the page's last Transaction ID, which is used as the reference point for forward navigation (PF8) to advance to the next page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully read and its original timestamp (TRAN-ORIG-TS) is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is preparing the transaction data for display on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction date is extracted from the original timestamp, with the year component taking only the last 2 digits (YY), and the date is formatted as MM/DD/YY (month, day, 2-digit year) for display in the transaction row's date field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Transaction Date to MM/DD/YY for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The transaction's original timestamp stored in the system is reformatted into a user-friendly MM/DD/YY date format before being displayed on the transaction list screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully read and its amount (TRAN-AMT) is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is preparing the transaction data for display on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is moved into the formatted working storage amount field (WS-TRAN-AMT) which applies the defined numeric display format including sign and decimal positions, and this formatted value is placed into the screen row's amount field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Transaction Amount for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The raw transaction amount from the file is formatted with appropriate sign and decimal representation before being placed into the screen display field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been read and its date and amount have been formatted
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the screen row corresponding to the current row counter (1 through 10)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction ID (TRAN-ID), formatted Transaction Date (WS-TRAN-DATE in MM/DD/YY), Transaction Description (TRAN-DESC), and formatted Transaction Amount (WS-TRAN-AMT) are all placed into the respective screen display fields for that row number (e.g., TRNID01I, TDATE01I, TDESC01I, TAMT001I for row 1 through TRNID10I, TDATE10I, TDESC10I, TAMT010I for row 10)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Transaction Row on Screen with All Four Data Fields
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each successfully read transaction record is displayed on the screen with all four data elements — Transaction ID, Transaction Date, Transaction Description, and Transaction Amount — placed into the corresponding fields of the appropriate screen row.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully read and all four data fields have been populated into the current screen row
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The population of the current row is complete
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The row counter (WS-IDX) is incremented by 1, and the system loops back to check whether the row counter is still within the 10-row limit and whether more records exist in the file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Row Counter After Each Successful Record Load
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each transaction record is successfully read and placed onto the screen, the row counter is incremented by 1 to advance to the next available display row, controlling the loop that fills up to 10 rows.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has finished loading records onto the current page (either 10 records were loaded or the end of file was reached) AND at least one record was successfully loaded onto the page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a peek-ahead by attempting to read one more record from the TRANSACT file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the additional record is found, the system marks that a next page is available (NEXT-PAGE-YES), enabling PF8 forward navigation; if no additional record is found (end of file), the system marks that no next page is available (NEXT-PAGE-NO), disabling PF8 forward navigation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Peek-Ahead Read to Determine If Next Page Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: After loading up to 10 transaction records onto the current page, the system attempts to read one additional record from the file solely to determine whether more transactions exist beyond the current page, enabling or disabling the forward navigation (PF8) option.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The forward page loading loop has completed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row counter (WS-IDX) is still at 1, meaning no records were successfully read and placed onto the page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks that no next page is available (NEXT-PAGE-NO) and skips the peek-ahead read, proceeding directly to incrementing the page number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark No Next Page When No Records Were Loaded
all_rules.Rule_Description: If no transaction records were loaded onto the current page at all (the file was empty or the starting position was at end of file), the system marks that no next page is available without performing a peek-ahead read.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The forward page data loading has completed, the peek-ahead check has been performed (if applicable), and the next-page availability flag has been set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: At least one record was loaded onto the page (WS-IDX is greater than 1)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The page number (CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM) is incremented by 1 and the updated page number is moved to the page number display field (PAGENUMI) on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Page Number After Forward Page Load
all_rules.Rule_Description: After completing the forward page data loading (regardless of whether a full page of 10 records was loaded or fewer), the current page number is incremented by 1 to reflect the newly displayed page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The forward page data loading loop and peek-ahead check have both completed and the page number has been updated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system has finished all required reads from the TRANSACT file for this page load operation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The browse session on the TRANSACT file is ended (ENDBR), releasing the file browse position

all_rules.Rule_Name: Close Transaction File Browse After Page Load
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all transaction records for the current page have been read and the peek-ahead check has been completed, the browse session on the TRANSACT file is closed to release the file resources.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The TRANSACT file browse has been closed and all screen fields (transaction rows, page number, header with current date and time, program name, transaction name) have been populated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is ready to present the updated transaction list to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction list screen (COTRN0A from mapset COTRN00) is sent to the user with the Transaction ID search input field cleared (set to spaces), displaying up to 10 transaction rows each containing Transaction ID, Date (MM/DD/YY), Description, and Amount, along with the current page number and any informational or error messages

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Updated Transaction List Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all transaction data has been loaded, formatted, and the page number updated, the transaction list screen is sent to the user displaying the populated transaction rows, current page number, header information, and any applicable messages.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction List screen and has pressed PF7 to navigate to the previous page, and the first transaction ID of the current page is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates a browse on the Transaction file using the first transaction ID of the current page as the starting position
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The browse is successfully positioned at the first transaction ID of the current page, ready for backward reading; if the transaction ID is blank or null, the browse starts from the lowest available transaction in the file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initiate Backward Browse from First Transaction ID of Current Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When navigating to the previous page, the system initiates a backward browse of the transaction file starting from the first transaction ID that was recorded on the current page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to start a browse on the Transaction file from the first transaction ID of the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The browse initiation fails due to an unexpected error (not a normal or not-found response)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the message 'Unable to lookup transaction...' on the Transaction List screen, and does not attempt to load any transaction records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Browse Initiation Failure on Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the transaction file browse cannot be initiated during backward page navigation, the system stops processing and displays an error message to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The browse has been successfully initiated on the Transaction file at the first transaction ID of the current page, and the key pressed was not ENTER or PF8
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs one backward read to advance past the current boundary record
