description:
COTRN00C is a CICS online program within the CardDemo application that provides a paginated list of credit card transactions retrieved from the TRANSACT file. It allows users to browse up to 10 transactions per page, navigate forward and backward through pages using PF7/PF8 keys, and select a specific transaction (using 'S') to view its details by transferring control to the COTRN01C program. This is a Main/Driver program that manages its own screen interactions and navigation flow via a communication area.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: VSAM/CICS File (TRANSACT) - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Initialize flags, clear error messages, and set default values at the start of each program execution cycle 2: Session Validation - Check if a valid user session exists (EIBCALEN); if no session found, redirect user to the sign-on screen 3: First-Time Screen Display - On first entry to the transaction list screen, initialize the screen layout and load the first page of transactions 4: Transaction List Screen Rendering - Display the transaction list screen with header information including current date, time, program name, and transaction ID 5: Screen Header Population - Populate screen header with application title, current date (MM/DD/YY format), current time (HH:MM:SS format), program name, and transaction ID 6: User Input Reception - Receive and capture user input from the transaction list screen including selection flags and transaction ID search criteria 7: Function Key Routing - Evaluate which key the user pressed (Enter, PF3, PF7, PF8, or other) and route to the appropriate processing logic 8: Transaction Selection Processing - Detect which row (1 through 10) the user has selected by checking selection flag fields, and capture the corresponding transaction ID 9: Transaction Detail Navigation - When user selects a transaction with 'S' or 's', transfer control to the Transaction Detail screen (COTRN01C) passing the selected transaction ID 10: Invalid Selection Validation - If the user enters a selection value other than 'S' or 's', display an error message indicating valid values 11: Transaction ID Search Input Validation - Validate that the entered Transaction ID search value is numeric; if not numeric, display an error message and re-display the screen 12: Transaction ID Search Initialization - If the Transaction ID search field is blank, set the search key to low values to start browsing from the beginning of the file 13: Forward Page Navigation (PF8) - When user presses PF8, advance to the next page of transactions using the last transaction ID of the current page as the starting point 14: Backward Page Navigation (PF7) - When user presses PF7, navigate to the previous page of transactions using the first transaction ID of the current page as the starting point 15: Top-of-List Boundary Check - When user presses PF7 and already on page 1, display a message indicating they are at the top of the list and prevent further backward navigation 16: Bottom-of-List Boundary Check - When user presses PF8 and no next page exists, display a message indicating they are at the bottom of the list and prevent further forward navigation 17: Forward Page Data Loading - Browse the transaction file forward from a given starting transaction ID, reading up to 10 transaction records to populate the current page 18: Backward Page Data Loading - Browse the transaction file backward from a given starting transaction ID, reading up to 10 transaction records in reverse to populate the current page 19: Transaction Data Initialization - Clear all 10 transaction display rows (ID, date, description, amount) on the screen before populating with new data 20: Transaction Record Population - For each transaction record read, format and place the transaction ID, date (MM/DD/YY), description, and amount into the appropriate screen row (1-10) 21: Transaction Amount Formatting - Format the transaction amount with sign and decimal notation for display on screen 22: Transaction Date Formatting - Extract and reformat the transaction origination timestamp into MM/DD/YY display format 23: First and Last Transaction ID Tracking - Record the transaction ID of the first record on the page and the last record on the page to support forward and backward pagination 24: Next Page Availability Detection - After loading a page, attempt to read one additional record to determine if a next page of transactions exists, and set the next-page indicator accordingly 25: Page Number Tracking - Increment or decrement the current page number as the user navigates forward or backward through the transaction list 26: Return to Main Menu - When user presses PF3, transfer control back to the main menu screen (COMEN01C) 27: Invalid Key Handling - When user presses an unrecognized function key, display an invalid key error message and re-display the current transaction list screen 28: Return to Previous Screen - Transfer control to the appropriate previous screen (sign-on or calling program) passing along session communication area data
